academic.passage: Photosynthesis is a fundamental biological process in which light energy is converted into chemical energy by plants, algae, and some bacteria. This process primarily occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells. Through photosynthesis, these organisms produce glucose from carbon dioxide and water, releasing oxygen as a byproduct. The overall reaction can be summarized as 6CO2 + 6H2O → C6H12O6 + 6O2. This remarkable process not only sustains plant life but also supports the entire ecosystem by providing oxygen and serving as the foundation of the food chain.
